title: Decompositions of ZMC Graphs and Euler-Ramanujan type identities
summary: In this paper, we study finite and infinite decomposition formulas for zero mean curvature (ZMC) graphs in Euclidean, Lorentz--Minkowski, and isotropic (3)-spaces. We first derive new Euler--Ramanujan-type identities that decompose the conjugate of Scherk's first minimal surface into dilated catenoids. Using Weierstrass factorisation and power series methods, we then obtain infinite decompositions for a broad class of isotropic ZMC graphs into helicoids, logarithmoids of revolution, and Enneper surfaces.
